title: GHT — transferFrom + sync Reserve Manipulation Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: Used GHT token's `transferFrom()` to drain the pair balance down to 1, called `sync()` to update reserves, then transferred a large amount of GHT back and exploited the price discrepancy via `swap()` to drain WETH
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] GHT.transferFrom(pair, attacker, pairBalance - 1)
  │         └─ Pair GHT balance reduced to 1
  │
  ├─→ [2] pair.sync()
  │         └─ reserve_GHT updated to 1
  │
  ├─→ [3] GHT.transferFrom(attacker, pair, pairBalance - 1)
  │         └─ Pair GHT actual balance = pairBalance
  │         └─ Reserve = 1 vs actual balance = pairBalance (extreme mismatch)
  │
  ├─→ [4] pair.swap(wethOut, 0, attacker, "")
  │         └─ Excessive WETH extracted based on reserve mismatch
  │
  └─→ [5] ~$57K WETH profit
